reference_fields: UNH Seedless Table Grape Variety and Training System Evaluation 2019
University of New Hampshire research update on seedless table grape cultivar performance and training systems in Durham, New Hampshire

locations.name: UNH Agricultural Experiment Station, Durham, New Hampshire

categories.name: Seedless table grape cultivars evaluated at UNH
categories.description: UNH evaluated these seedless table grape cultivars in Durham, New Hampshire from 2016 to 2019

extractors.category: Seedless table grape cultivars evaluated at UNH

description_parts.template: UNH evaluated {name} as a seedless table grape in Durham, New Hampshire. Fruit color: {fruit_color}. 2016-2019 ratings: anthracnose {anthracnose}, downy mildew {downy_mildew}, powdery mildew {powdery_mildew}, vigor {vigor}

rows.name: Canadice
rows.harvest_time: 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Tight, very attractive and uniform clusters
rows.trial_notes: 2019 preliminary results say Mars and Canadice produced more marketable fruit than all other varieties
rows.conclusion: UNH preliminary conclusions identify Mars and Canadice as most promising for commercial production of seedless table grapes in the region

rows.name: Concord Seedless
rows.harvest_time: early maturing; 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Small clusters with some variability in fruit size; prone to cracking; early maturing

rows.name: Lakemont
rows.harvest_time: among the earliest to mature; 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Moderately loose clusters of uniform golden-green fruit with nice flavor
rows.conclusion: UNH says Vanessa and Lakemont produced very high quality fruit, but their limitation was susceptibility to downy and powdery mildews

rows.name: Marquis
rows.harvest_time: among the last to mature; 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Latest to mature of these cultivars; beautiful clusters of large fruit; skin somewhat tough

rows.name: Mars
rows.harvest_time: among the last to mature; 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Tight, very attractive and uniform clusters
rows.trial_notes: Mars produced higher yields than all other varieties in 2018, at 22 to 27 pounds per vine, and was among the top marketable-yield cultivars in 2019
rows.conclusion: UNH preliminary conclusions identify Mars and Canadice as most promising for commercial production of seedless table grapes in the region

rows.name: Reliance
rows.harvest_time: among the earliest to mature; 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Somewhat loose clusters; inconsistent ripening and color development; prone to shattering

rows.name: Thomcord
rows.harvest_time: among the earliest to mature; 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Poor fruit set, leading to uneven clusters; some bird damage due to minimal canopy cover
rows.trial_notes: UNH observed the highest mortality and lowest vigor for Thomcord

rows.name: Vanessa
rows.harvest_time: among the earliest to mature; 2019 harvest period was Sept 15 to Oct 4
rows.fruit_notes: Loose clusters of oval-shaped berries; fruit are firm and crisp with excellent flavor
rows.conclusion: UNH says Vanessa and Lakemont produced very high quality fruit, but their limitation was susceptibility to downy and powdery mildews
